content_blocks.title: Acme Orders Service
content_blocks.summary: The Acme Orders Service accepts order requests, validates inventory, stores order state, and publishes fulfillment events.
content_blocks.text: The Acme Orders Service accepts order requests, validates inventory, stores order state, and publishes fulfillment events.

content_blocks.title: Components
content_blocks.text:
- HTTP API receives order submissions.
- Inventory client checks stock before confirmation.
- Orders database stores order status.
- Event publisher emits fulfillment events.
items: Inventory client checks stock before confirmation.

content_blocks.title: Risks
content_blocks.text:
- Inventory failures delay confirmation.
- Duplicate submissions require idempotency keys.
- Event publishing must not happen before order state is committed.
items: Event publishing must not happen before order state is committed.
